newsitem.title: UK: UK to issue 500 million Ecu of three-year notes.
newsitem.headline: UK to issue 500 million Ecu of three-year notes.

text.p: The UK Treasury will hold a tender for 500 million Ecu of three-year notes to be issued on January 28, the Bank of England said on Tuesday.
The notes would mature on January 28, 2000 and will be offered for sale by tender on a bid-yield basis, the BOE said.
An additional 50 million Ecu of notes would be allotted directly to the Bank of England.
"Notes will bear an annual coupon paybable on January 28, starting on January 28 1998," the BOE said. "Payment for notes allotted in the tender will be due on January 28, 1997."
The Bank of England also said it would bring forward the timing of the publication of the results of tenders by one hour.
"The bank will now aim to publish the results of tenders at 12 noon (local time), beginning on January 21, 1997," the BOE said.
It added it had revised its market maker list and made technical changes to the tax section of its information memorandum.
